notes.title: patch 0.5.1 is live
notes.content:
Hello Gardeners!

Today we're bringing you a new patch that addresses multiple issues and introduces exciting new features:

New Mechanics:

[list]
[*] Parcel Box: All non-furniture items purchased in the shop now spawn in a special parcel box outside the apartments.
[*] Orders System: Starting on Day 2, players can access and choose generated orders via their PC or the parcel box.
[/list]

Improvements:

[list]
[*] Continuous music playback added for enhanced ambiance.
[*] Special items introduced for streamers.
[/list]

Major Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*] Resolved an issue causing beds to despawn.
[*] Fixed item duplication in quick access slots.
[*] Corrected an issue where soil could be improperly removed from pots.
[*] Fixed issue where produce sometimes spawned attached to the parent plant.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.5.0 live
notes.content:
Hello Gardeners!

We’re thrilled to bring you our latest update, packed with fixes, reworks, and exciting new mechanics! Here’s what’s changed:

[b]New Additions[/b]

[list]
[*] Storage Boxes: A brand-new mechanic! You can now store fruits and other items in boxes and fridges, making inventory management more convenient.
[*] Missing Recipes Added: We’ve filled in the gaps with all the missing recipes for a more complete cooking experience.
[/list]

[b]Mechanic Rework[/b]

Energy System Overhaul: To streamline the gameplay loop, energy mechanics have been redesigned.
[list]
[*] You’ll now start each day with 100% energy.
[*] Energy is consumed by performing various activities, adding strategy to how you spend your day.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Development Mini-Job: This mini-job now has three distinct modes for added depth and variety.
[*] Time Management Enhanced: Actions in the game now consume significantly more time, emphasizing the importance of planning your day effectively.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where items would randomly disappear.
[*] Added missing colliders to certain items for better interaction.
[/list]

As always, thank you for your support and feedback. We can’t wait to see how you use the new features and improvements!

notes.title: Patch 0.4.9.7 is live
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where items would disappear from the inventory.
[*] Resolved an issue where pot names displayed incorrectly after loading a saved game.
[*] Fixed sound not playing correctly for cooking completion.
[*] Addressed localization errors in the English version of the game.
[*] Resolved an issue where fruits were not spawning properly, preventing players from cooking food.
[/list]

Gameplay Changes:

[list]
[*] The stove is now immovable to improve placement stability.
[*] Recipe unlocks have been moved to the PC interface for better accessibility.
[/list]

New Features:

[list]
[*] Added a brand-new tutorial to enhance the onboarding experience.
[/list]
